biggest_gap: Market scale starves the scouting game: one 16-club league with ~266 scoutable targets, where a single scout takes a top target from a masked P$254K-742K range to 100% knowledge and a full report in ~10 days — the discovery/uncertainty engine that makes FM24's global, effectively inexhaustible scouting hub a season-long strategic layer collapses into a two-week checklist here.

history.gap: One-dimensional negotiations: single-scalar fee + wage spinboxes; no installments, sell-on clauses, loans, contract length or bonuses — the core of FM's deal-structuring loop is absent.

No transfer windows or deadline day: the market runs uniformly all year with no time pressure, no rival competition for targets, and no end-of-window drama — the emotional core of FM's Transfer Centre is missing.

No recruitment pipeline around the deal engine: FM24's hub PUSHES targets at you — shortlists, scout recommendation queues, agent-offered players, transfer rumours, DoF delegation — while this screen is entirely pull-based: a flat 268-row search table and two dual-role coach-scouts, no shortlist, no rumour mill, no scout hiring/network, so between deals the centre is inert.
